assessment: This fundamental work substantially advances our understanding of the development of the craniofacial skeleton requires interactions between progenitor cells and the collagen-rich extracellular matrix (ECM). The evidence supporting the conclusions is compelling, with rigorous biochemical assays, state-of-the-art localization and lineage tracing studies, and phenotype and genetic analysis of Ddr2-deficient mice. The work will be of broad interest to cell biologists and developmental biologists.
